Replace only the four large red neck-scarf components across the top row with four slim woodland field headbands/brow bands for front/down, rear/up, left, and right: narrow dark berry-red cloth bands with a tiny side knot and short tails, shallow enough to sit across the upper forehead without covering eyes or face, each fully hollow and isolated.
